Kitsap Animal Rescue & Education (KARE) is an volunteer-powered, non-profit organization, based out of Kitsap County, whose mission is to provide animal welfare education as well as animal rescue/shelter support for the community. 
Adopt | Foster | Volunteer | Donate | Learn

Learn more by visiting www.nwkare.org
Follow us on Facebook: www.Facebook.com/NWKARE
Follow us on Twitter: www.Twitter.com/NorthwestKARE
